title: Québec Mega Trail — trail runner rules
claims: Each missing mandatory item at a gear check adds a 30-minute penalty, and more than two missing items means immediate disqualification.
Runners must respect cut-off times and hand in their bib if they reach a feed zone after the cut-off.
The race director may modify the course at any time, even during the race, and may cancel or postpone the event.
The first 30 men and 20 women receive a GPS tracker that must be worn for the whole race.
